name: Kolkata
tagline: India's cultural capital of colonial grandeur, sweets and poetry
summary: Kolkata is India's intellectual and artistic heart, a city of crumbling colonial grandeur, book markets and sweet shops. See the white marble Victoria Memorial, cross the Howrah Bridge to the flower market, watch idol makers in Kumartuli, visit Mother Teresa's Mother House and eat kathi rolls and rosogolla.
seasonNote: November to February is cool and dry; Durga Puja in October is spectacular but crowded; summer is very hot and the monsoon heavy.
arrival: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Airport is 45 to 75 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Metro, yellow Ambassador taxis and Uber; the historic tram runs a few lines.
cashTip: Carry small rupee notes for rickshaws, street food and tips; UPI is everywhere but is difficult for visitors.
foodTip: Kathi rolls, Bengali fish curry, mishti doi and rosogolla.
buyTip: Books on College Street, Bengal cotton saris and terracotta.
baseArea: Park Street or around the Maidan
